title: Proof length of the quadratic circuit reduction
statement: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits. The proof length of the three-query semantic PCPP reduction associated with $C$ is $C$’s quadratic PCPP proof length plus $64s$, where $s$ is the number of random seeds in the four-query PCPP system for $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
